description: Search query expander (RAG) — Turns one search query into better retrieval input for web search, vector search and RAG: intent, n alternative rewrites (n=2-8, default 5), core keywords with synonyms, sub-questions, a HyDE passage to embed, a ready boolean query ((a OR b) AND c), inferred filters, and all_queries for parallel search + rank fusion. Optional domain= (e.g. legal, medical, ecommerce). Price: $0.005 USDC (Base, via x402).

q.description: e.g. how do I lower my AWS bill

name: ai_query_expand
